alex: quick Q — saw a 502 in prod and the frontend logged X-Request-Id=rb-9f4c2. Where's the shortest path to grab the raw request/response logs across edge -> gateway -> pod?

mira: start with the edge proxy logs (it usually logs the incoming X-Request-Id). if you have the id use the logging console first: Logs Explorer -> query: request_id:\"rb-9f4c2\" and set time range +-5m. link: https://console.redwood.example/logs?query=request_id%3A%22rb-9f4c2%22

jamie: if console doesn't show it (eg header rewritten) try the node/ingress directly from k8s:
```
# find recent lines with the id
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/edge-proxy -c proxy --since=10m | rg rb-9f4c2
# or use stern for pod tailing
stern edge-proxy -n prod --since 10m | rg rb-9f4c2
```

mira: also check for X-Trace-Id in headers — frontend sometimes reports trace id instead. if you have a trace id use Traces -> search: trace_id:\"<id>\" to pull spans and a span->log link.

alex: got a span id in the browser: span=00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01, how do I get logs?

jamie: open traces, click the root span, there should be a \"Related logs\" panel with links to log lines. if that panel is empty: confirm our span-to-log correlation config is enabled for that service (sampling and instrumented log lines).

mira: extra tip — some proxies strip the original header and append a new one like X-Req-Proxy. run this quick grep to see variants: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/edge-proxy -c proxy --since=15m | rg -i \"rb-9f4c2|X-Request-Id|X-Req-Proxy|X-Trace-Id\"`

jamie: if you're blocked, paste the raw header payload here and I can point to the exact pod/line. also adding the timestamp helps. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — ran stern and found it in edge-proxy with header X-Req-Proxy: rb-9f4c2 at 2026-03-17T14:12:04Z. found a span link in the log pointing to span id above. opening trace now.

sre-bot: quick helper — Saved query added for rb-9f4c2: https://console.redwood.example/logs?saved=rb-9f4c2 (expires in 24h). Use this if you need to hand off.

mira: followup for ops: we should add a short runbook snippet to Observability README for cross-proxy header variants and the stern snippet. filing a tiny PR.

alex: perfect — will leave a note in the incident channel with the console links.
